summary: Apply credit vintage, roll-rate and profitability analysis to banking decisions. Review the five-day course outline and see what you will practise.
lede: Banking analytics helps credit, portfolio and customer strategy professionals use loan, deposit and customer data to guide exposure and relationship decisions. The course covers credit vintage and delinquency roll-rate analysis, expected credit loss interpretation, and risk-adjusted product profitability, using Excel-based summaries and decision-focused reporting. Participants also assess deposit attrition and customer value to compare segments and prioritize portfolio reviews.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who use banking portfolio or customer information to shape credit, product and relationship decisions.
modules: Basel III Capital and Portfolio Metrics
prerequisites: Working knowledge of banking products, loan or deposit portfolios, and basic financial or credit measures is recommended. Basic Excel skills are useful. No coding or programming is required.
